GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Shade slow away. Not pushed early & raced Mid Field Two Wide (3L from lead). Stayed Mid Field Two Wide midrace & pushed to quicken 3 Wide (2L from lead) on home turn. Pressured Four Wide @ 200m & held ground in last 100m. # Every Chance

Jumped only fairly & Settled Down 7 Lengths Two Wide , Drifted Back to 9 Lengths rail turning, Dropped Out in straight. (Blinkers FIRST TIME) [Stewards: Rider reported it failed to travel at any stage. Post-race vet exam revealed no abnormalities.] # weakened badly
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Rider reported that her mount failed to travel at any stage of the event. A post-race veterinary examination revealed no abnormalities.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok held rail 4l off, under pressure turn and dropped out # poor
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Near the 650m, had to be checked to avoid the heels of another runner which was also checked to avoid the riderless horse.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: jumped awkwardly . Not pushed early & raced well back 3 Wide With Cover (5L from lead). In Two Wide @ rear midrace & pushed out 3 Wide @ 450m. Pushed along Six Wide (5L from lead) on home utrn. Hampered @ 150m & not ridden out late. # Found trouble.
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Began awkwardly from the outside barrier and then was shifted behind runners in the early stages.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok drifted back 4l off, ridden along turn, Straightened Up 3-4l off, battled on well just no threat # did enough
Jumped Ok drifted back 4l off, ridden along turn, Straightened Up 2-3l off all clear and battled on well to the line # had run/sound
Jumped Fair settled box seat 2 Lengths off, ridden along turn, Straightened Up 1-2l off, found little and faded # weak run home
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Began awkwardly and made contact with the hindquarters of another runner

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Well sat 2nd 2 Lengths off, improved turn, Straightened Up 1 length off all clear, same 200m, running on took over passing 100m and drew clear # had run/too good
not best away and sat back long last 13 Lengths 700m, still well back on turn, weaved a passage last 200m and Made Good Ground but from too far back # best work late
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Change of tactics: Intention to be ridden further forward; settled back. Was slow to begin. Rider reported her mount raced greenly under pressure in the home straight and proved difficult to fully test.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Bumped @ start. No early speed & raced @ rear (out of picture) early . Stayed same until pushed out 3 Wide @ 500m. Pushed to quicken Five Wide (5L from lead) on home turn. Pressured Six Wide @ 250m & making ground @ 200m & not fully ridden out late. # Not fully tested.
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: On jumping bumped. Raced keenly during the early and middle stages.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Well Restrained Outside Leader 0.5l. Ridden Along closer Turn but Under Pressure on Straightening Up . Quickly No Match and Weakened . vet = 2/5 lame # on pace - amiss
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Raced keenly during the early and middle stages. App reported her mount travelled well until the 500m where it came under pressure and proved disappointing in how it finished its race off. A post-race veterinary examination revealed the gelding to be lame (2/5) in the off foreleg. Trainer was advised a veterinary clearance would be required before the gelding is permitted to race or barrier trial again.  Vet clearance received.
